task: ФОКУСНЫЙ КОДОВЫЙ атом (operator, РЕАЛИЗУЙ+КОММИТЬ КОД, НЕ discuss/документ). OKO видео шаг 2/2: TelegramReporter шлёт ВИДЕО инцидента. КОНКРЕТНО: src/oko/live/reporters.py — в TelegramReporter.report(): если bridge_output.incident_video_path задан и файл существует → Telegram sendVideo (multipart/form-data, поле video=mp4-файл) с caption=bridge_output.description (VLM-текст); иначе текущий sendPhoto(keyframe)-fallback. Acceptance ОБЯЗАН: pytest — payload с incident_video_path → reporter дёргает sendVideo с файлом (HTTP мокнуть); payload без видео → sendPhoto. Один концерн, тесты зелёные. Это РЕАЛИЗАЦИЯ кода с коммитом, не decision-документ.
goal: To enhance `TelegramReporter` to send incident videos via `Telegram sendVideo` when `bridge_output.incident_video_path` is provided and valid, using `bridge_output.description` as the video caption, while maintaining the existing `sendPhoto` fallback for keyframes.
constraints: Implement and commit code directly; no discussion or documentation is required.
Modifications must be confined to the `TelegramReporter.report()` method within `src/oko/live/reporters.py`.
The `Telegram sendVideo` call must use `multipart/form-data` with the MP4 file in the `video` field and `bridge_output.description` as the `caption`.
The existing `sendPhoto` (keyframe) fallback mechanism must be preserved if `incident_video_path` is not provided or the file does not exist.
The implementation must address a single concern.
All existing tests must remain green.
known_context: This task is step 2/2 of the OKO video feature implementation.
The `bridge_output` object may contain `incident_video_path` (a file path) and `description` (VLM-generated text).
An existing `TelegramReporter` class and its `sendPhoto` mechanism are in place.
success_tests: A pytest test case exists where a payload with a valid `incident_video_path` causes `TelegramReporter.report()` to call `Telegram sendVideo` with the specified video file and `caption` from `bridge_output.description` (mocking HTTP calls to Telegram API).

A pytest test case exists where a payload without `incident_video_path` (or with an invalid/non-existent path) causes `TelegramReporter.report()` to call `Telegram sendPhoto` (mocking HTTP calls to Telegram API).
All existing tests pass after the changes.
